reranked_evidence.title: HIGH Definition & Meaning
reranked_evidence.snippet: # high. 1. having a great or considerable extent or reach upward or vertically; lofty; tall. 2. having a specified extent upward. > *The apple tree is now 20 feet high.*. 3. situated above the ground or some base; elevated. > *a high platform;* *a high ledge.*. 2. a little sharp, or above the desired pitch. > *the high altar of a church.*. advanced to the utmost extent or to the culmination. *Phonetics.* (of a vowel) articulated with the upper surface of the tongue relatively close to some portion of the palate, as the vowels of *eat* and *it,* which are high front, and those of *boot* and *put,* which are high back. 1. at or to a high point, place, or level. 2. in or to a high rank or estimate. 3. at or to a high amount or price. 4. in or to a high degree. 4. a high or the highest point, place, or level; peak.
